reasoning: Recent Georgia polling in the last 45 days points to a Democratic lead in the 2026 Senate race. The clearest state-specific public survey found Jon Ossoff ahead of Mike Collins by 9 points, and a more recent report from August 18 said Ossoff was up 7 points in an InsiderAdvantage poll; I did not find a state-specific current presidential-margin poll for Georgia in the last 45 days. Georgia’s statewide Cook PVI is D+4.

sources.name: AARP Poll
